verdict.rationale: Bulk-style capability is only indirect. QBO Advanced can sync spreadsheet data to cut manual work, automatic rules categorize transactions, and statement reminders go to late-paying customers in a few clicks. For agents, the official MCP server exposes full CRUD and search across 29 entity types, but nothing documents batch endpoints or bulk edits, so mass changes would mean looping over per-item calls. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API or MCP batch tool, bulk edit/delete of many records in the UI, limits and error handling for bulk jobs, and hands-on corroboration.
